name: OpenFIGI API
summary: Free API for mapping tickers, ISINs, CUSIPs and other identifiers to FIGIs, plus instrument search and filter.
description: OpenFIGI assigns Financial Instrument Global Identifiers (FIGI) to securities across asset classes. The mapping endpoint takes a batch of jobs (identifier type, value, optional exchange or currency) and returns matching instruments with FIGI, share-class and composite FIGI, name, ticker, exchange code and security type. Search and filter endpoints find instruments by keyword. A free key raises limits.

auth.notes: Works without a key at lower limits; a free key from the signup page raises rate limit and batch size.

rate_limit.summary: Without a key: 25 mapping requests per minute and 10 jobs per request; with a free key 250 per minute and 100 jobs per request. Search and filter are lower (5 and 20 per minute). Per IP without a key.

endpoints.summary: Map up to 10 identifier jobs (100 with a key) to FIGIs; body is a JSON array
Keyword search for instruments; the response includes a next token
Filter instruments by keyword and attributes
Allowed values for idType, exchCode and other fields

license.name: Not stated for the data on the pages checked; the OpenAPI spec is Apache-2.0

agent_notes: Mapping is POST with a JSON array and returns an array in the same order; each element has either data or a warning. One identifier can map to many listings, so add exchCode or micCode to narrow it. Use /mapping/values/idType to see valid idType strings (ID_ISIN, ID_CUSIP, TICKER and more). Windows are 60 seconds and ratelimit-* headers show the remainder.
caveats: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header was returned on the POST (and the preflight carried none), so browser calls are not usable; call from a server.
Requests with more than 10 jobs without a key are rejected with 413.
Rate-limit windows start at your first request and last 60 seconds.
The docs state the API is free to use without daily, weekly or monthly limits.

verification.notes: Example executed keyless: 200, ratelimit-limit 25 seen. /search, /filter and /mapping/values/idType also 200.
